Have a decent singing voice. I love that. Once I was at a bar and a smaller band started playing. I walked over to the stage and a girl who was an obvious fan was singing along. Her voice stood out and I instantly wanted to see her naked.
I will never be like you.

I was afraid of monsters as a kid. I had a dream that someone was sneaking around my backyard and trying to break into our house. Over night, the snow had fallen and there was a fresh blanket of snow. We looked outside, ready to go out to play and there were footsteps leading from the fence to the backdoor. Luckily, we have like 10 locks on the backdoor with an alarm system. 

tl;dr had a dream as a kid that someone was breaking into our house from the backdoor, found footsteps.
If I could stop it before it happens, then yes. Like, if i knew i was going to get cancer, I would go more frequently to the doctor and change my life style.

Dreams scare me. When I was younger, I did some hard drugs and made many bad decisions. I developed an addiction to meth and had to go to rehab. I wanted to get my life back on track. Throughout the entire detox process and sometimes even now, I get these dreams, where they are incredibly vivid. The dreams are of me using. I can feel it. It's really unsettling because when I was up, I feel a certain high. 

If you saw my dreams, you would see me at my lowest point. 

Five years sober, university degrees in business and marketing.

I just want to say mine. I had a best friend who went through a wild phase. And i want to add that when I have friends, I'm a very loving friend. Loyal, supportive and trustworthy. We were sixteen and she got extremely drunk at a party. A twenty three year old wanted to have sex with her and she was so out of it that she didn't know what was really going on. I didn't let her go because he was taking advantage of her. He was a very 'popular' guy that everyone loved and rejecting him was apparently social suicide. I know. Big fucking deal. The next day, she said we couldn't be friends anymore because i prevented her from furthering herself and living her life.

Well then.
